verses.1: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; give praise in the heights.
verses.2: Praise him, all you angels; give praise, all you hosts.
verses.3: Praise him, sun and moon; give praise, all shining stars.
verses.4: Praise him, highest heavens, you waters above the heavens.
verses.5: Let them all praise the LORD'S name; for the LORD commanded and they were created,
verses.6: Assigned them duties forever, gave them tasks that will never change.
verses.7: Praise the LORD from the earth, you sea monsters and all deep waters;
verses.8: You lightning and hail, snow and clouds, storm winds that fulfill his command;
verses.9: You mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars;
verses.10: You animals wild and tame, you creatures that crawl and fly;
verses.11: You kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all who govern on earth;
verses.12: Young men and women too, old and young alike.
verses.13: Let them all praise the LORD'S name, for his name alone is exalted, majestic above earth and heaven.
verses.14: The LORD has lifted high the horn of his people; to the glory of all the faithful, of Israel, the people near to their God. Hallelujah!

notes.text: Highest heavens: literally, "the heavens of the heavens," i.e., the space above the firmament, where the "upper waters" are stored. Cf Genesis 1:6-7; Deut 10:14; 1 Kings 8:27; Psalm 104:3, 13.
The LORD has lifted high the horn of his people: horn = strength, the concrete noun for the abstract. Of all peoples God has chosen Israel to return praise and thanks in a special way.
